title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: article describes standard dictionary govhr, organized four main modules: Establishment, Personnel, Contract, Allowance. modules designed organize standardize information public sector personnel across different countries administrative levels.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Establishment module captures information public sector institutions, including ministries, departments, agencies, along sector classification geographic/administrative location.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Sector: Uses COFOG (Classification Functions Government) classification categorize establishments. Administration vs. Geography: Administration levels (adm1/adm2/adm3) refer institutional/administrative divisions (e.g., Ministry, Department, Agency), geography levels (geo1/geo2) refer physical location (e.g., state/region, municipality/county).

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Personnel module contains demographic employment information individual public sector employees.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Employment Status: Used together ref_date detect movement events hires, fires, retirements (see classify_personnel_event()). Educational Attainment: Follows World Bank’s Global Labor Database (GLD) 7-level classification convention. Tenure Fields: personnel_tenure tracks overall public sector tenure, distinct contract_tenure Contract module, tracks tenure within specific contract. Privacy Considerations: module contains sensitive personal information handled according applicable data protection regulations.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Contract module captures details employment contracts, compensation, job characteristics.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Compensation Fields: Base, gross, net salary fields (local currency ) allow analysis gross--net ratios effect deductions allowances. Itemized allowance amounts tracked separately Allowance module. Contract Type (International): Follows ILO’s ICSE-18 (International Classification Status Employment) standard cross-country comparability, contract_type_native preserves local terminology. Occupation Coding: native standardized (ISCO-08) classifications enable within-country detail cross-country comparability. Tenure vs. Seniority: contract_tenure tracks time worked current contract, seniority tracks level within paygrade.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Allowance module captures detailed, itemized allowance payments associated contract, allowing analysis allowance composition beyond aggregate allowance_lcu figure Contract module.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: Granularity: Unlike aggregate allowance_lcu field Contract module, module stores one row per allowance type per contract per reference date, enabling detailed breakdowns allowance composition.

title: Standard dictionary for `govhr`
text: four modules related follows: One establishment can many contracts. One person can multiple contracts (time concurrent). One contract can multiple itemized allowances.
code: Establishment (1) ←→ (N) Contract Personnel (1) ←→ (N) Contract Contract (1) ←→ (N) Allowance

Passed straight estimate_decrement_rates(). age_col single string naming age column. status_col single string naming employment status column. value "active" identifies "stayed" outcome survival chain built . personnel_id_col single string naming personnel identifier column. ref_date_col single string naming reference date column. group_cols character vector additional columns (e.g. gender, service type) compute separate service table , NULL single table whole population. radix Numeric. size synthetic starting cohort youngest observed age. Purely normalizing constant – cancels ex represent real people. Defaults 100000. smooth Logical. Whether graduate decrement rates via smooth_decrement_rates() chaining. Defaults FALSE: raw pooled rates chained directly, unless group_cols stratum age gap, case compute_service_table() smooths reactively (warning) regardless setting, since chain run gappy age sequence. title: Compute an actuarial service table from a personnel panel — compute_service_table
text: data.table one row per age / group_cols: age_col, group_cols supplied. px Probability remaining active age x x+1. lx Survivors age x, radix youngest age: \(l(x) = radix \prod_{y<x} p(y)\). lx_next Survivors age x+1: \(l(x) \cdot p(x)\). Lx Person-years service age x x+1: \((l(x) + l_{next}(x)) / 2\) (trapezoidal approximation, assuming exits spread uniformly across year). Tx Total remaining person-years service age x onward: \(\sum_{y \ge x} L(y)\). ex Expected remaining years service age x: \(T(x) / l(x)\).

text: Internal workhorse intended called roll_snapshot_pairs() inside future estimate_decrement_rates(), mirroring role .compute_transition_pair() plays movement rates. Given two consecutive panel snapshots (snap_t0 T0 snap_t1 T1), function: Defines exposure cohort every person status_col == "active" T0, tabulates exposure age_col/group_cols using person's T0 age group – ages never shifted, since individuals tracked identity rather aggregated independently per snapshot. Looks cohort member's status_col value T1 via native data.table join (x[, =]) personnel_id_col. Anyone absent snap_t1 altogether (.e. dropped panel) assigned synthetic outcome "non-retirement-exit". title: Generate Standard HR Analytics Report — generate_hr_report
text: Produces comprehensive HTML analytics report harmonized HR data using Quarto template. report includes descriptive statistics, visualizations, optional quality control diagnostics across Contract, Personnel, Establishment modules.

title: Generate Standard HR Analytics Report — generate_hr_report
text: contracts data.table containing Contract module data harmonized column names according dictionary. include columns contract_id, personnel_id, est_id, ref_date, salary fields, occupation information. personnel data.table containing Personnel module data harmonized column names. include personnel_id demographic information. establishments data.table containing Establishment module data harmonized column names. include est_id establishment characteristics. country_code reference country code. Must specified three-letter, World Bank standard (e.g., BRA Brazil). output Character string specifying output file name. Defaults "hr_report.html". file created current working directory. contract_dt Deprecated. Use contracts instead. personnel_dt Deprecated. Use personnel instead. est_dt Deprecated.
